item.title: Higher petrol and diesel prices push UK inflation to 3.6%
item.body: There are also signs that inflation is affecting the wider economy, with the cost of raw materials and of goods leaving factories both climbing.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📊 Higher petrol and diesel prices push UK inflation to 3.6%

There are also signs that inflation is affecting the wider economy, with the cost of raw materials and of goods leaving factories both climbing.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
